scope_note: The three indexed rounds are release-included as DESCRIPTIVE. L3 repair records 2/6 rescues, below the registered three-rescue threshold, with preservation unmeasured, no round environment record, and unproven rule chronology. L3b records an observed KEEP only for eight selected failures, conditional on a private per-test check; 3/24 scored cells have Standard records, the host captures followed execution, the public rule commit followed the first start, and the deviation and later hidden-suite exposure are disclosed. The language replication retains raw rates, but its combined registered decision is UNRESOLVED because the four-pass formula and scale are absent; design provenance, host separation, and reused cells from another window limit the comparison. Public reproducibility is incomplete for all three. L4b-confirm is published descriptively with an explicit public-evidence gap: its Standard 1.2 run records and smoke/strict-validation receipts are unavailable, so strict checklist compliance is not established. The Kogen-RS tier-1 round (kogen-rs-ladder-luna-r74x) is likewise published descriptively with an explicit public-evidence gap: its lane grade ledgers, run manifests, Standard 1.2 run records and smoke/strict-validation receipts are not in the public snapshot, so strict checklist compliance is not established and its per-cell values are source-reported. Historical archive status and analysis-only pages retain their round-specific scope.
